text_block_list.text:
Having traveled all the way to Hokkaido to 
run in the Sapporo Kinen, Fine Motion was 
immediately surrounded by reporters.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion! How are you feeling for this 
run?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is beyond reproach. Above all—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san is coming along, so I'm 
really looking forward to it♪

Indeed, the powerhouse running in the 
Sapporo Kinen was Fine Motion's roommate— 
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We've made it all the way here together 
today as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly... you're always so easy to find.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Groove-san. Saying that in front of 
everyone... you're making me blush♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I meant noisy in a bad way! Don't go 
twisting it into something positive!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the sparks are already flying...! Air 
Groove-san, how do you feel about facing 
off against Fine Motion-san?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*ahem*

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I am well aware of her 
strength. Though this showdown was 
entirely unexpected...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In a way, you could say my wish came true. 
You'll make it entertaining for me, won't 
you, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... And so, it looks like I'll be able 
to put on a great race for everyone. 
Please look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
We're looking forward to it as well! Good 
luck to both of you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to give Groove-san a surprise...

Right before the race, she suddenly 
muttered something strange...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"With everyone expecting so much from us, 
we've gotta treat them to a fun surprise!"
choice_data_list: I don't think it means that, though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, you don't have to take it that way. I 
just want to do it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"My opponent is Groove-san, you know? It 
would be disrespectful to fight normally."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For example... holding back your pace in 
the rear, saving and saving and saving 
your energy...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I whoosh right past Groove-san at the 
very end, she'll be super surprised, 
right?

"It's what you'd call an 'End Closer' 
running style, but... depending on your 
current condition, it might be worth 
considering."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave what you actually want to do up 
to you♪ Because even if you just run 
normally—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to be surprisingly strong, 
after all. Right?♪
